policy.stationVisibility: Every EVSE from the current Swiss national source remains in the bundle regardless of CPO complete/blocked/partial status.
policy.tariffOverlay: Only validated deterministic direct-tariff production artifacts are overlaid. Missing tariff never removes an EVSE.

policy.otherPriceLayers: Electra, Electroverse and subscription-adjusted prices are intentionally separate runtime overlays and are not replaced by this direct-CPO bundle.
